dialogues.jp:
疲れは十分とれてるし、起きるか。せっかくの
休日をベッドの上だけで過ごすのはもったいな
いし。
dialogues.en:
Even if I'm still tired, I'd get up. No point in letting the
long-awaited rest day pass over on top of my bed.
dialogues.text:
Even if I'm still tired, I'd get up. No point in letting the
long-awaited rest day pass over on top of my bed.

dialogues.jp:
目を開けると、まず最初に見慣れた天井が目に
映る。
dialogues.en:
I open my eyes, and quickly become acquainted with the
ceiling.
dialogues.text:
I open my eyes, and quickly become acquainted with the
ceiling.

dialogues.en: "Huahhh..."
dialogues.text: "Huahhh..."

dialogues.jp: 身体を起こし、大きな｛あくび／欠伸｝をする。
dialogues.en:
I rise into a sitting position on my bed, and release a huge
yawn.
dialogues.text:
I rise into a sitting position on my bed, and release a huge
yawn.

dialogues.jp: そういや、音夢のやつはどうしたかな？
dialogues.en: Now then, where is that Nemu?
dialogues.text: Now then, where is that Nemu?

dialogues.jp: 具合が治っていればいいけど。
dialogues.en: I hope she's resting to heal her condition.
dialogues.text: I hope she's resting to heal her condition.

dialogues.jp: 「よっしゃ！　起きるか」
dialogues.en: "Alright! Time to get up!"
dialogues.text: "Alright! Time to get up!"

dialogues.jp:
気合一発、自分に呟くと、ベッドから下りて私
服に着替える。
dialogues.en:
With a forceful yell, I jump up, and change into my usual
clothes.
dialogues.text:
With a forceful yell, I jump up, and change into my usual
clothes.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おはよう、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, nii-san."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, nii-san."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もう起きてたか、具合はどうだ？」
dialogues.en: "You're up already? How are you feeling?"
dialogues.text: "You're up already? How are you feeling?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん。いつも通りすっきり」
dialogues.en: "I'm fine. As always, refreshed from the sleep."
dialogues.text: "I'm fine. As always, refreshed from the sleep."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いつも通り、ね」
dialogues.en: "As always, huh."
dialogues.text: "As always, huh."

dialogues.jp:
音夢の言葉に苦笑しつつ、ソファーに座りテレ
ビのリモコンを探す。
dialogues.en:
Smiling bitterly to myself at Nemu's words, I plop onto the
sofa and start searching for the remote control.
dialogues.text:
Smiling bitterly to myself at Nemu's words, I plop onto the
sofa and start searching for the remote control.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、私これから美春と遊びに行くから」
dialogues.en: "Brother, I'm going to meet up with Miharu."
dialogues.text: "Brother, I'm going to meet up with Miharu."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「遊びにってお前、昨日ぶっ倒れてたのに大丈
　夫か？」
dialogues.en:
"Going out? Are you sure you'd be okay after you collapsed
yesterday?"
dialogues.text:
"Going out? Are you sure you'd be okay after you collapsed
yesterday?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「さっき治ったって言ったでしょう？　それに、
　日曜に遊んでおかないとね♪」
dialogues.en:
"I told you I was feeling fine, didn't I? Besides, what
better day to have fun that a Sunday.♪"
dialogues.text:
"I told you I was feeling fine, didn't I? Besides, what
better day to have fun that a Sunday.♪"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあ、行ってきます」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, I'm going."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, I'm going."

dialogues.jp:
俺の言葉を笑顔で流し、そのまま出て行ってし
まう。
dialogues.en: Sinking my advice with that smile of hers, she heads out.
dialogues.text: Sinking my advice with that smile of hers, she heads out.

dialogues.jp:
ソファーに思いっきり背を預けて、大きくため
息をつく。
dialogues.en: I slump deeper into the sofa, and sigh loudly.
dialogues.text: I slump deeper into the sofa, and sigh loudly.

dialogues.jp: 「また具合が悪くなってもしらんぞ」
dialogues.en: "Don't blame me if your condition worsens again."
dialogues.text: "Don't blame me if your condition worsens again."

dialogues.jp: やれやれ――だ。
dialogues.en: Oh well.
dialogues.text: Oh well.

dialogues.jp: 俺もあとで、どこかに行くか。
dialogues.en: Now where should I go...
dialogues.text: Now where should I go...

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢は美春と遊びに行く◆
dialogues.en: ◆Nemu Going Out with Miharu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Nemu Going Out with Miharu◆

dialogues.jp:
具合が良くなったらしい音夢は、美春と遊びに
行くらしい。
dialogues.en:
Although she wasn't fully well yet, Nemu still went out with
Miharu.
dialogues.text:
Although she wasn't fully well yet, Nemu still went out with
Miharu.

dialogues.jp: 全く……具合が悪くなっても知らないぞ。
dialogues.en:
Really... I don't know if her condition really is bad or
not.
dialogues.text:
Really... I don't know if her condition really is bad or
not.
